exit: 0
--- stdout
CDL.Reals.Hysteresis
  Transform Real to Boolean signal with Hysteresis

parameters:
  uLow : Real (required)
      if y=true and u<uLow, switch to y=false
      range: uLow <= uHigh; uLow == uHigh warns
  uHigh : Real (required)
      if y=false and u>uHigh, switch to y=true
      range: uLow <= uHigh; uLow == uHigh warns
  pre_y_start : Boolean = false
      Value of pre(y) at initial time

inputs:
  u : Real
      Input to be compared against hysteresis values

outputs:
  y : Boolean
      Output value of comparison

notes:
  (none)

links:
  source at the pinned Buildings commit: https://github.com/lbl-srg/modelica-buildings/blob/a131864e4c4df22ebcd52bb8da439de0087ac365/Buildings/Controls/OBC/CDL/Reals/Hysteresis.mo
  help in the latest Buildings release (may drift from the pin): https://simulationresearch.lbl.gov/modelica/releases/latest/help/Buildings_Controls_OBC_CDL_Reals.html#Buildings.Controls.OBC.CDL.Reals.Hysteresis
